name: Karen LeBlanc
bio: Karen LeBlanc is an award-winning Canadian actress, singer, and voice artist known for her versatility across television, film, and musical theatre. With a career spanning over three decades, she has become a prominent figure in North American television, currently starring as Detective Dreyfus in Law & Order Toronto: Criminal Intent (2024–2026) and as Zola Augustin in the series Saint-Pierre (2025–2026). She is best known for her role as Inspector Diane Caligra in CBC's Cracked (2013).
